name: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation.
descriptionMd: The "Insulated Vehicle" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote efficient and hygienic fish transportation systems. Under this scheme, a financial grant is provided to the beneficiaries for purchasing insulated (reefer) vehicles used in fish transportation. It seeks to minimize post-harvest losses, improve fish value chains, and enhance earnings of fish farmers by enabling cold-chain logistics.
benefitsMd: **Financial Assistance:** - Financial grant of up to ₹20,00,000/- per unit for the purchase of an insulated (reefer) vehicle. **Grant Limits:** - 40% of the unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - 60% of the unit cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries. > **Note** - Subsidy is applicable for one vehicle per beneficiary only. - Central assistance is released only after initiating fishery activity. - The applicant should agree that any losses in procurement, operation, or maintenance are their own responsibility, and not that of the Government of India or Haryana.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant should be a fish farmer. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must ensure that the fish transportation facility is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant must not have availed a grant for a similar insulated (reefer) vehicle earlier.
